visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black bucket hat, a black face mask, and a black hoodie holds a long, glowing white light tube horizontally above his head. He stands in an office setting with a light wood pillar and a window in the background. A circular portrait of a smiling man is overlaid at the bottom. (2) A male interviewee with short dark hair, wearing a pink and brown horizontal striped polo shirt, sits at a light wood table. He holds a black microphone with a yellow Lipton logo. Two bottles of Lipton milk tea stand prominently on the table in front of him against a bright blue wall. (3) The man in the black hoodie hides behind a wall or pillar while holding the light tube, while a female staff member in a black cap and brown shirt assists with the lighting setup in the background. (4) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white shirt and a Unilever lanyard, is interviewed in the same office setting. She smiles and speaks into the Lipton-branded microphone, with the branded tea bottles still on the table. (5) A man with glasses wearing a denim jacket is interviewed next. He speaks with expressive hand gestures. The background features a large white circular logo on the blue wall, and the lighting is bright and even. (6) A woman in a light pink shirt and a silver necklace is interviewed. She laughs and covers her mouth with her hand. The man in the black hoodie is seen standing close by, still holding the light tube as if he were part of the crew. (7) The woman in the pink shirt turns around to face the 'lighting technician.' Upon seeing the man in the black hoodie lower his mask, she bursts into laughter, covering her face. (8) In a series of reveal shots, the various interviewees are shown reacting with surprise and laughter as the man in the hoodie reveals his identity. (9) The man in the striped polo shirt is seen talking back to the man in the hoodie, gesturing with his hands while everyone laughs together in the brightly lit office space.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar strumming at 124 BPM provides a cheerful background. A female voice with a clear, professional tone poses an introductory question. (2) A male voice with moderate pitch answers casually. A sharp 'ding' SFX punctuates the transition. (3) The female interviewer asks follow-up questions. Responses from multiple different male and female voices are heard with frequent rhythmic cuts. (4) Vocal arousal increases as a female voice bursts into loud, high-pitched laughter. The BGM remains steady with a light drum beat. (5) Multiple voices overlap in high-valence excitement as identities are revealed. Sound effects like 'popping' bubbles accompany text transitions. (6) A final male voice speaks with an amused, slightly higher pitch, followed by collective group laughter and a quick musical fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Setup -> Multiple Interviews -> Surprise Reveal -> Humorous Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Lipton milk tea through a humorous 'social experiment' vlog where a famous influencer (HowHow) disguises himself as a crew member to surprise people being interviewed about him.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent placement of Lipton bottles, branded microphone, and company lanyards throughout the video.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes the influencer's persona to create an engaging promotional piece for Lipton, relying on rapid editing and genuine reactions.
